scope: 25 offline decoded MTAR animation previews; titled GIFs and thumbnails only, no game animation or model payloads

tooling.referenceRevisionStatus: Cited source pin from catalog; actual installed Python file hashes recorded separately, not an assertion for arbitrary caller tool directories

skinning.method: Original stock mesh geometry and weight values; native groups mapped to author DEF names, duplicate target groups merged preserving per-vertex sums; standard Blender Armature modifier
skinning.duplicateChoice: First/proximal split segment in author supplied map
skinning.secondaryMotion: Hair/scarf/holster bones inherit mapped ancestor motion; no native secondary simulation

timing.sampling: Every second source frame in 0..N-1; clean endpoint N saved separately
timing.gifQuantization: Durations rounded cumulatively to 10ms GIF units, preserving chosen total duration to nearest10ms

limits: Reference Ocelot appearance does not identify the original source actor
Receiver clips are not ordinary NPC attacker combos
Front/back phase relationships remain naming-based hypotheses
Each clip is shown alone, without its partner or a held weapon/equipment prop
CQC/asr family names do not by themselves prove unarmed punching semantics; source role confidence remains naming-based without native contextual verification
